component.name: Creator Toolkit
component.summary: Compress, resize and convert images, video, audio and PDFs for sharing

description.p: Creator Toolkit helps content creators optimize and convert media before sharing it online. Fully offline.

ul.li: Images: compress, resize, crop to an aspect ratio, convert (JPG, PNG, WEBP)
Video: compress, convert (MP4, MKV, MOV, WEBM, GIF), trim
Audio: compress, convert (MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG)
Social media presets for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook

description.p: Results are saved to the CreatorToolkit folder in your home folder. This package includes FFmpeg for the video and audio tools.
